diagnostic_attempts.reason: The first generator guard looked for a nonexistent q3 output field instead of the authoritative minimal_q3_support row; the source contract was corrected before generation.

A monolithic reduction over all 1296 output/input coordinates caused excessive Lean memory use. All diagnostic compiler processes were terminated, and the proof was factored into six exact output-sector certificates.
The first generated Lake build lacked a scoped recursion-depth annotation on the typed-path count theorem; the annotation was added before the passing build.

A final audit shell omitted the pinned Lean toolchain directory from PATH, so the replay could not start lake. The replay was rerun with PATH=/home/alstrup/.elan/bin:$PATH and passed with all three Lean exit codes zero.
A direct norm_num proof over the newly derived paths expanded the 22-by-22 constructor into an oversized term and left reduction goals. It was not accepted as a proof.
A native_decide diagnostic compiled the direct evaluator but introduced six native-decide axiom boundaries. It was rejected and replaced by a kernel-checked path-equality transfer proof.

Plain decide could not reduce the rational evaluator proposition definitionally. The accepted proof instead derives path equality, proves the exact source arithmetic, and transfers zero to the derived-path evaluator without native-decide axioms.
